title: GenSPARQL: A Generative Extension of SPARQL for Incomplete Knowledge Graphs
abstract: arXiv:2611.26062v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Knowledge graphs on the Web are incomplete, and SPARQL answers a query only from the stored triples. Large language models (LLMs) can predict missing facts, but an LLM returns names instead of IRIs and requires one call per binding of a query variable. We present GenSPARQL, a generative extension of SPARQL 1.1 with an operator GENOP that binds values generated by an LLM to query variables during query evaluation. A similarity join maps generated names to entities of the graph, and the query planner invokes the LLM only for the bindings selected by the other graph patterns and filters. In a web workbench, attendees query two graphs built from Wikidata and inspect generated values, mapped entities and LLM calls. In our evaluation with three open-weight LLMs, the embedding similarity maps 83% of the entities named by the LLMs and yields only one incorrect match.

translated_title: GenSPARQL：面向不完整知识图谱的SPARQL生成式扩展
translated_abstract: Web上的知识图谱是不完整的，而SPARQL仅能根据已存储的三元组来回答查询。大型语言模型（LLM）可以预测缺失的事实，但LLM返回的是名称而非IRI，并且每绑定一个查询变量就需要调用一次。我们提出了GenSPARQL，这是SPARQL 1.1的一个生成式扩展，其中包含算子GENOP，可在查询求值过程中将LLM生成的值绑定到查询变量。相似度连接将生成的名称映射到图中的实体，而查询规划器仅为其他图模式和过滤器所筛选出的绑定调用LLM。在一个Web工作台中，与会者可以查询两个基于Wikidata构建的图，并查看生成的值、映射的实体以及LLM调用情况。在我们使用三个开源权重LLM的评估中，基于嵌入的相似度成功映射了LLM所命名实体的83%，且仅产生一次错误匹配。
tldr: 提出GenSPARQL，通过在SPARQL 1.1中新增GENOP算子，在查询求值时将LLM生成的值绑定到查询变量，并借助相似度连接与查询规划器按需调用LLM，从而高效补全不完整知识图谱中的缺失事实。
en_tdlr: GenSPARQL extends SPARQL 1.1 with a GENOP operator that binds LLM-generated values to query variables during query evaluation, using similarity joins and a query planner to invoke the LLM only when needed, efficiently filling in missing facts in incomplete knowledge graphs.
